title: Framer media placeholder
description: Plain stand-ins for media on a black page: a #171717 well, a #111 panel, either one optionally fading into the page towards its right or bottom edge like the original's UI shots, or a panel with a soft blue glow rim. Nothing is drawn inside.
notes: fills the box it is given; radius, border and size come from the parent or className
pass children to show real media inside
name: framer-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description:
well: muted surface (media inside cards) · panel: card surface (windows, side panels) ·
glow: card surface with a soft blue rim of light

props.name: fade
props.description: fade into the page towards one edge, as the original's cropped UI shots do

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Product video")

props.name: children
props.description: real media to show instead of the empty surface
